create_PolarsDataFrame: create a PolarsDataFrame interchange object backed by a Polars DataFrame with optional allow_copy parameter
test___dataframe__: test the __dataframe__ method constructs a new PolarsDataFrame interchange object with configurable parameters
review_num_columns_num_rows: review the num_columns and num_rows methods that return the number of columns and rows in the dataframe
summarize_get_columns_select_columns: summarize the get_columns and select_columns methods that iterate and filter dataframe columns by index or name
refactor_get_chunks: refactor the get_chunks method to iterate over dataframe chunks with optional sub-chunk splitting by n_chunks parameter
